title: BdH Timeline Map 7: Huge Space Station | WORLDDOWNLOAD

generated.description: A very large sci-fi style space station built mostly from iron blocks, with a long central spine, a bulbous main hull and smaller arms and pods sticking out from it. Its surfaces mix white, gray and black wool with glass windows, emerald blocks, obsidian and glowstone accents, and some areas show mycelium and ice. It measures about 115 wide, 133 high and 124 deep, and contains interior rooms with chests, enchanting tables, furnaces, a record player and a few lava and water features.
